# 017 — Package Local Runner

Status: `[PLANNED]`

## Purpose

Prepare the project for repeatable local execution.

## Context

The user should be able to clone, install, and run the app consistently.

## Scope

Document setup, dependencies, run commands, and troubleshooting.

## Out of scope

No installer, no app store packaging, no background service.

## Inputs

Validated MVP.

## Outputs

Runnable local package and setup docs.

## Implementation requirements

Document optional speech dependencies separately from core keyboard mode.

## Acceptance criteria

Fresh setup can run keyboard mode without speech dependency.

## Manual validation

Clone into a clean environment and run setup instructions.

## Dependencies

016 — Manual MVP Validation

## Next step

Future specs may add hotword detection, macros, GUI, or online adapters.
